recommendation: Keep the commit. If FHIR-I wants a separate two-part-only value set rather than the existing FHIR-version value set plus major.minor documentation, that should be handled as a focused terminology follow-up rather than as part of this seed reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking to correct $versions output parameter descriptions, change examples from valueString to valueCode, and bind the code-valued outputs to a value set of major FHIR releases.
initial_application: The explicit FHIR-26065 commit 556e177ba0 added a required FHIR-version binding only to the default output parameter. The repeated version parameter stayed unbound. The valueCode example correction was later applied by FHIR-35928.
additional_context: FHIR-26067 and FHIR-35168 later replaced the old publication.major/minor terminology with the current major.minor.patch-label model and added major.minor release-line codes to the FHIR-version code system, so the current major.minor wording should remain. FHIR-35928 is already represented on the combined branch and the current examples already use valueCode.
reconciliation: Added the same required http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/FHIR-version binding to OperationDefinition.parameter[version] that was already present on OperationDefinition.parameter[default]. No wording or example changes were made because those parts are already consistent with later applied decisions.
source_changes: source/capabilitystatement/operationdefinition-CapabilityStatement-versions.xml: added a required FHIR-version ValueSet binding to the repeated version out parameter.
